identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Ramucirumab (LY3009806) Versus Placebo in Participants With Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Elevated Baseline Alpha-Fetoprotein
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 3 Study of Ramucirumab and Best Supportive Care (BSC) Versus Placebo and BSC as Second-Line Treatment in Patients With Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Elevated Baseline Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP) Following First-Line Therapy With Sorafenib

armGroups.label: Ramucirumab + Best Supportive Care (BSC)
armGroups.description: 8 milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg) ramucirumab administered as an intravenous (IV) injection on day 1 of each 14 day cycle. Participants may continue treatment until discontinuation criteria are met.

armGroups.label: Placebo + BSC
armGroups.description: Placebo administered IV on day 1 of each 14 day cycle. Participants may continue treatment until discontinuation criteria are met.

armGroups.label: Open Label Ramucirumab + BSC
armGroups.description: 8 mg/kg ramucirumab administered IV on day 1 of each 14 day cycle. Participants may continue treatment until discontinuation criteria are met.

armGroups.label: Ramucirumab MEE Cohort + BSC
armGroups.description: 8 mg/kg ramucirumab administered IV on day 1 of each 14 day cycle. Participants may continue treatment until discontinuation criteria are met.

armGroups.label: Placebo MEE Cohort + BSC
armGroups.description: Placebo administered IV on day 1 of each 14 day cycle. Participants may continue treatment until discontinuation criteria are met.
